title: The Vacant Throne
visual_bible: Photorealistic coastal West African village. Exteriors in warm pastel tones (peach, soft teal) under natural sunrise/sunset light. Interiors stark and sterile with cold digital fluorescent lighting. Symmetrical framing indoors to suggest surveillance, asymmetrical handheld outdoors for human freedom. Color palette shifts from warm exterior to cold interior whites and system alert reds.
continuity_rules: Kwame sits in a modern wheelchair with a mounted tablet on the armrest throughout interior scenes.
The house exterior must maintain consistent pastel hues across all exterior shots.
System interface glow remains a specific cool white/blue, never warm.
Kofi wears a neutral casual shirt in all scenes to blend with domestic setting.
Lighting transitions from natural dawn to artificial night strictly following the script timeline.

shots.title: Dawn Exterior
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of a pastel coastal village house at sunrise. Soft peach walls, teal trim. A shadow of a drone passes over the roof. Warm morning light hitting the porch.
shots.vector_fallback_prompt: Wide shot of a pastel coastal village house at sunrise with drone shadow.
shots.material_and_lighting: Natural soft sunlight, pastel textures, high dynamic range.
shots.continuity_anchors: House color, sunrise position, drone shadow angle.
shots.motion_plan: Static tripod, slight slow push in.
shots.sound_plan: Ocean waves, distant engine hum, rising drone buzz.

shots.title: Kwame on Porch
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot of an elderly man sitting in a modern wheelchair on a porch. He looks out at the sea. Warm lighting, dignified posture.
shots.vector_fallback_prompt: Elderly man in wheelchair on porch looking at sea.
shots.material_and_lighting: Rough wood porch, soft skin tones, morning sun.
shots.sound_plan: Calm waves, breathing, wind in palms.

shots.title: Tablet Handover
shots.image_prompt: Over shoulder shot of a woman holding a tablet. Screen glows cool blue. The man in wheelchair is in the background out of focus.
shots.vector_fallback_prompt: Woman holding tablet with cool blue screen.
shots.material_and_lighting: Indoors near door, cold screen light on face, warm ambient.
shots.continuity_anchors: Tablet model, cool light color, woman outfit.
shots.motion_plan: Slow track right following the tablet tap.
shots.sound_plan: Footsteps, tablet tap click, chair electric hum.

shots.title: Interior Living Room
shots.image_prompt: Wide static shot of living room. Symmetrical composition. Walls are pale, floor is tiled. A wheelchair sits center. Cold light.
shots.vector_fallback_prompt: Symmetrical living room with wheelchair in center.
shots.material_and_lighting: Tiled floor, white walls, fluorescent overheads.
shots.continuity_anchors: Room layout, furniture position, light temp.
shots.sound_plan: Low hum, silence, chair motor whir.

shots.title: Book Rearrangement
shots.image_prompt: Close up on hands rearranging books on a shelf. Book spine colors muted. In reflection on glossy surface, a face looks on.
shots.material_and_lighting: Glossy book covers, soft desk lamp light.
shots.continuity_anchors: Book arrangement, shelf wood, reflection face.
shots.motion_plan: Handheld, slightly shaky as hands move.
shots.sound_plan: Book sliding sound, soft voice muffled.

shots.title: System Alert
shots.image_prompt: Extreme close up on digital interface screen. A red line pulses briefly. No text visible. Cold white background.
shots.vector_fallback_prompt: Digital screen interface with red pulse.
shots.material_and_lighting: Glowing LCD, cool white, sharp focus.
shots.continuity_anchors: Screen color, pulse timing, interface style.

shots.title: Kitchen Coffee
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot kitchen counter. A cup placed on surface. Warm morning light from window. Hand places cup down.
shots.material_and_lighting: Ceramic cup, wooden counter, window light.
shots.sound_plan: Cup clink, water pouring, soft sigh.

shots.title: Window Reflection
shots.image_prompt: Profile shot of man looking out window. Glass reflects a dark screen. Outside is bright sea. Inside is dim.
shots.vector_fallback_prompt: Man looking out window with screen reflection.
shots.material_and_lighting: Glass reflection, dark interior, bright exterior.
shots.continuity_anchors: Reflection clarity, window frame, face profile.

shots.title: Dock Wide
shots.image_prompt: Wide shot of wooden dock. Several men standing without faces clearly visible. Nets and rope. Natural sun.
shots.continuity_anchors: Dock structure, net position, sea state.

shots.title: Kwame Approaches Dock
shots.image_prompt: Back view of wheelchair moving on wooden planks toward dock. Sunlight glares. Movement towards sea.
shots.material_and_lighting: Wood planks, lens flare, bright outdoor.
shots.sound_plan: Wheel on wood, wind, distant speech.

shots.title: Firmware Refusal
shots.image_prompt: Medium shot living room. Woman holds tablet. Man shakes head. Cold light from window.
shots.vector_fallback_prompt: Woman holding tablet man shaking head.
shots.sound_plan: Silence, chair hum loud, low alert tone.

shots.title: Darkening Screen
shots.image_prompt: Close up on screen dimming from white to black. No icons. Just light fading.

shots.title: Night Laughter
shots.image_prompt: View from window looking out at dark sea. Faint light on dock. No clear figures. Night time.
shots.vector_fallback_prompt: Window view of dark sea and dock.
shots.continuity_anchors: Window frame, sea darkness, light points.

sound_design_plan: Separate tracks for wind and digital hum.
Use silence as punctuation after system chimes.
qa_gates: Verify cultural dialect and gesture accuracy.
Check tech UI does not look like generic tech.
Ensure accessibility subtitles do not break visual silence.
Confirm all tech effects achievable in post.
